messages.summary: Shipper submits claim for PRO BLF-77209115; shipment arrived May 12 (after May 8 delivery date) with 2 cartons missing and 5 cartons crushed/wet; demands $29,920.00 covering shortage/damage, inspection/rework, promotion markdown, and freight refund.
Carrier requests BOL, invoice, POD, photos, and inspection report, and asks for cargo loss amount to be separated from late-delivery business impact.

Shipper provides BOL, invoice, POD, and two photos; invoice shows 240 units at $425 each; POD shows 2 short/5 damaged cartons of 4 units each; direct shortage/damage calculated at $9,350.00; inspection write-up still pending.
Carrier notes only two photos received, not covering all five cartons; requests inspection report and packaging specification; flags EDI 59-piece count vs POD 58-carton discrepancy.

Shipper submits inspection report finding 20 units from 5 cartons, 14 unsellable/6 repackable, with internal foam present; no vendor packaging spec available; asserts $18,000 markdown from missed MetroMart May 10 promotion launch.

Carrier asserts Standard LTL service position excluding consequential/loss-of-market damages; accepts 8 missing units and 9 of 14 damaged units, disputes remaining 5; offers $7,225.00 excluding inspection/repack, markdown, and freight refund.

Shipper disputes exclusion of the 5 units, citing POD and inspection corroboration and internal foam finding; asks carrier to reconsider cargo amount, inspection/repack costs, and delay impact as a commercial compromise.
